sentences.text: A computational model incorporating internal feedback loops in the prefrontal cortex and external signal transmission between two brain regions was constructed to simulate neural dynamics.

Mathematical analysis revealed that this system exhibits chaotic behavior and multiple stable states, and the resulting chaotic sequences demonstrated high security against attacks when tested for image encryption.
The authors conclude that these fractional models are effective for both simulating brain functions and creating encryption schemes, though the findings remain limited to computational simulations.
